foundation_barrier.feature_rule: Every declared module has real bounded typed API and executable minimum consumer/failure path, independent compiler/closure evidence and HBR posture before feature MTs run. Foundation does not mean full vendor parity; missing proprietary decoder can expose real opaque/loss rejection while editable-decoder feature remains explicitly blocked. No no-op/canned PASS.
foundation_barrier.host_rule: Host-neutral bridge foundation does not depend on core/native/DB; actual embedding MTs retain full later runtime acceptance and cannot be satisfied by transient asset proof

shared_owners.live_database: SurrealDB/EventLedger only; no SQL engine or additional DB; new proposal requires operator approval with reason and preferred database comparison
shared_owners.catalog: Existing CKC and ArtifactService; no Studio-owned catalog/CAS/watcher/cache
shared_owners.jobs: Existing logical Job Runtime through typed ports; Session admission adapter is not second scheduler authority
shared_owners.mutation: Document-scoped proposal/commit actor with target/property revision read/write footprint; immutable parallel compute
shared_owners.controls: Controls single mechanic owner with configured panel/widgets; extend capability before sibling asset
shared_owners.telemetry: Observe shared ports to FlightRecorder/internal_diagnostics/Palmistry existing owners
shared_owners.manual: Existing canonical UserManual fed by same command/control descriptors

forbidden_edges.reason: Independent Studio asset development must not trigger kernel/native application graph.
Schema reuse and small-model work require a cheap pure boundary.

risks: Source adoption is selective leaf code only with pinned hashes/patch/license provenance. Toolkit host pins stay0.33 family until separately approved upgrade; no measured compile improvement/runtime/parity claim.
plugin_owner: Handshake-wide 5.1.6/11.8 canonical platform; Studio domain projections/providers only; shared lifecycle is planned prerequisite, not existing support.
